acceptanceCriteria: A documentation-only change with Runtime-generated lifecycle records selects the light route and does not launch unrelated release gates.
Actual .ai policy or release-owned changes remain strict.
Route regression tests pass and the existing CI workflow remains valid.
goal: Make route selection and its regression tests distinguish generated lifecycle evidence from source/CI policy changes while preserving strict routing for actual governance and release changes.
intent: Prevent Runtime-generated governance records from escalating documentation-only pull requests into unrelated strict release validation.
